name: ContextMenu
description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a right click.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The root. Placement lives on ContextMenuContent (side:, align:, offsets).
  class ContextMenu < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "context-menu",
          controller: "ruby-ui--context-menu"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A toggle in the menu (role menuitemcheckbox). Activating it flips
  # aria-checked, keeps the menu open and fires ruby-ui--context-menu:change
  # with {checked} in the detail.
  class ContextMenuCheckboxItem < Base
    ITEM = [
      "group/context-menu-checkbox-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
      "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-inset:pl-8",
      "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(checked: false, inset: false, disabled: false, shortcut: nil, **)
      @checked = checked
      @inset = inset
      @disabled = disabled
      @shortcut = shortcut
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        render ContextMenuItemIndicator.new(kind: :checkbox)
        yield if block
        render ContextMenuShortcut.new { @shortcut } if @shortcut
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menuitemcheckbox",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {checked: @checked.to_s, disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "context-menu-checkbox-item",
          inset: @inset,
          disabled: @disabled,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--context-menu#activate pointermove->ruby-ui--context-menu#hover pointerleave->ruby-ui--context-menu#leave"
        },
        class: ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The menu. A native popover (top layer), opened at the pointer and placed
  # by Floating UI; side:/align: pick the placement, side_offset:/align_offset:
  # the gap, with the defaults of shadcn's ContextMenuContent.
  class ContextMenuContent < Base
    SIDES = %i[top right bottom left].freeze
    ALIGNS = %i[start center end].freeze

    def initialize(side: :right, side_offset: 0, align: :start, align_offset: 4, **)
      @side = SIDES.include?(side.to_sym) ? side.to_sym : :right
      @side_offset = side_offset
      @align = ALIGNS.include?(align.to_sym) ? align.to_sym : :start
      @align_offset = align_offset
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menu",
        tabindex: "-1",
        popover: "manual",
        data: {
          slot: "context-menu-content",
          ruby_ui__context_menu_target: "content",
          action: "keydown->ruby-ui--context-menu#keydown",
          closed: "",
          side: @side,
          align: @align,
          preferred_side: @side,
          side_offset: @side_offset,
          align_offset: @align_offset
        },
        class: [
          "fixed inset-auto m-0 border-0 z-50 max-h-(--available-height) origin-(--transform-origin)",
          "overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto outline-none",
          "bg-popover text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 min-w-36 rounded-md p-1 shadow-md duration-100",
          "data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95",
          "data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-closed:fill-mode-forwards",
          "data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2",
          "data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # A group of items (role group), named by the ContextMenuLabel inside it.
  class ContextMenuGroup < Base
    def initialize(id: nil, **)
      @id = id || "context-menu-group-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      super(id: @id, **)
    end

    # The children are captured first, so aria-labelledby only points at a
    # ContextMenuLabel that actually rendered.
    def view_template(&block)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_context_menu_group]
      names = context[:ruby_ui_context_menu_group] = {label_id: "#{@id}-label"}
      body = block ? capture(&block) : ""
      group_attrs = names[:labelledby] ? mix({aria: {labelledby: names[:labelledby]}}, attrs) : attrs
      div(**group_attrs) { raw(safe(body)) }
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_context_menu_group] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        data: {slot: "context-menu-group"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # An action. A div by default; href: makes it a link. variant: :destructive
  # paints it red, inset: lines it up with items that have an indicator.
  # shortcut: renders a ContextMenuShortcut; checked: true (kept for
  # compatibility) renders a ContextMenuCheckboxItem instead, while
  # checked: false stays a plain item, as before.
  class ContextMenuItem < Base
    ITEM = [
      "group/context-menu-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
      "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground focus:*:[svg]:text-accent-foreground",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-inset:pl-8",
      "data-[variant=destructive]:text-destructive data-[variant=destructive]:focus:bg-destructive/10",
      "dark:data-[variant=destructive]:focus:bg-destructive/20 data-[variant=destructive]:focus:text-destructive",
      "data-[variant=destructive]:*:[svg]:text-destructive",
      "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(href: nil, variant: :default, inset: false, disabled: false, shortcut: nil, checked: false, **attrs)
      @href = href
      @variant = (variant.to_sym == :destructive) ? :destructive : :default
      @inset = inset
      @disabled = disabled
      @shortcut = shortcut
      @checked = checked
      @user_attrs = attrs
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      if @checked == true
        return render ContextMenuCheckboxItem.new(checked: @checked, inset: @inset, disabled: @disabled, shortcut: @shortcut, **@user_attrs), &block
      end

      tag = @href ? :a : :div
      send(tag, **attrs) do
        yield if block
        render ContextMenuShortcut.new { @shortcut } if @shortcut
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        href: @href,
        role: "menuitem",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "context-menu-item",
          variant: @variant,
          inset: @inset,
          disabled: @disabled,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--context-menu#activate pointermove->ruby-ui--context-menu#hover pointerleave->ruby-ui--context-menu#leave"
        },
        class: ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The check of a ContextMenuCheckboxItem / ContextMenuRadioItem, shown only
  # while the item is aria-checked="true". Rendered by those items.
  class ContextMenuItemIndicator < Base
    # Full class names, so Tailwind finds them when it scans the source.
    SHOW_WHEN_CHECKED = {
      checkbox: "group-aria-checked/context-menu-checkbox-item:flex",
      radio: "group-aria-checked/context-menu-radio-item:flex"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(kind:, **)
      @kind = kind
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template
      span(**attrs) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          aria_hidden: "true"
        ) { |s| s.path(d: "M20 6 9 17l-5-5") }
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        data: {slot: "context-menu-item-indicator"},
        class: ["pointer-events-none absolute right-2 hidden items-center justify-center", SHOW_WHEN_CHECKED.fetch(@kind)]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A heading. Inside a ContextMenuGroup the first label names the group
  # (aria-labelledby) and its own text is hidden from the accessibility tree.
  class ContextMenuLabel < Base
    def initialize(inset: false, **)
      @inset = inset
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      names = context[:ruby_ui_context_menu_group]
      return div(**attrs, &) if names.nil? || (!attrs[:id] && names[:labelledby])

      id = attrs[:id] || names[:label_id]
      names[:labelledby] ||= id
      div(**mix({aria: {hidden: "true"}}, attrs.merge(id: id)), &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "context-menu-label", inset: @inset},
        class: "text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium data-inset:pl-8"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Groups ContextMenuRadioItems: checking one unchecks the others. Like
  # ContextMenuGroup, a ContextMenuLabel inside it names the group.
  class ContextMenuRadioGroup < ContextMenuGroup
    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        data: {slot: "context-menu-radio-group"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # One choice of a ContextMenuRadioGroup (role menuitemradio). Activating it
  # checks it, unchecks its siblings, keeps the menu open and fires
  # ruby-ui--context-menu:change with {checked, value} in the detail.
  class ContextMenuRadioItem < Base
    ITEM = [
      "group/context-menu-radio-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
      "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-inset:pl-8",
      "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(value: nil, checked: false, inset: false, disabled: false, **)
      @value = value
      @checked = checked
      @inset = inset
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        render ContextMenuItemIndicator.new(kind: :radio)
        yield if block
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menuitemradio",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {checked: @checked.to_s, disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "context-menu-radio-item",
          value: @value,
          inset: @inset,
          disabled: @disabled,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--context-menu#activate pointermove->ruby-ui--context-menu#hover pointerleave->ruby-ui--context-menu#leave"
        },
        class: ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class ContextMenuSeparator < Base
    def view_template
      div(**attrs)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "separator",
        aria_orientation: "horizontal",
        data: {slot: "context-menu-separator"},
        class: "bg-border -mx-1 my-1 h-px"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class ContextMenuShortcut < Base
    def view_template(&)
      span(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "context-menu-shortcut"},
        class: "ml-auto text-xs tracking-widest text-muted-foreground group-focus/context-menu-item:text-accent-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The area that opens the menu on right click (or the ContextMenu key).
  class ContextMenuTrigger < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "context-menu-trigger",
          ruby_ui__context_menu_target: "trigger",
          action: "contextmenu->ruby-ui--context-menu#handleContextMenu"
        },
        class: "select-none"
      }
    end
  end
end
